answer_1.quote: We focus on style, a key component of communication, and find that modern LLMs often destroy style during translation... We develop a method where we learn stylistic concepts and leverage available native text to align style during translation without degrading translation quality.
answer_1.outputs: Style-aligned translations of source sentences across languages

answer_2.quote: In addition to calculating style alignment, we also calculate two popular reference-free translation metrics: GEMBA and COMETKIWI.

answer_4.quote: We run an annotation study on Prolific... Annotators are then shown 30 randomly selected samples, along with their RASTA translations and their "preserve style" prompting translations, and asked to select which translation better preserves style.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select which of two translations better preserves the style of the original text.
